rv.q: A CHORUS LINE runs at Skokie Theatre through the weekend of October 8 – a nice long run – leaves you no excuse not to see it!
If you've never seen A Chorus Line , or if you're a fan of the show like me, it's worth the trip to see this version even with certain technical aspects that get in the way.
As I said earlier, this is a solid production that should be on your to see list.
Aside from a few minor gaffs as mentioned this show was great fun and very enjoyable.
The production of A Chorus Line waiting for you at Skokie Theatre is a far different approach than I have seen done before.

cn.t: This Skokie Theatre production succeeds on a challenging small stage, with critics praising the tight choreography and ensemble dancing while noting some imperfections don't diminish the show's enduring appeal.
